02

Specified for offices & institutions

Four product families that suit large windows, patio doors, boardrooms and busy buildings. Every line below comes from the current site’s own product pages. Where the site gives no figure, this page says so.

Spec 01

Vertical blinds, with chains

Photo: vertical blind bottoms and chain, from the current site
Suits
Large windows and patio doors. The current site’s page description reads “best for your office or big doors”.
Control
Pull cord and chain.
Light
Light-filtering fabrics (Groups 1 and 2) or block-out fabrics (Savana Block, Corona Block Out).
Ranges
Plain, Van Gogh, Fleck, New Easton and Itaca ranges.
Fitting
Top-fix bracket inside the windowsill or face-fix bracket on the wall above. Measuring needs 90mm depth for an inside mount; add 100mm for an outside mount.
Max size
Not stated on the current site.
Spec 02

Chainless vertical blinds

Photo: chainless bottom-weight option, from the current site
What it is
A chainless bottom-weight option. The weights are completely sealed into the bottom pocket of each vane.
Why it suits
No bottom chain means fewer repairs for broken chains. The site says it also reduces the risk of accidents and injuries to children and pets.
Durability
Heat-sealed bottom weights, so the vanes are less prone to damage and to opening at the seams.
Ranges
Maggie (Gr 1), Regal (Gr 2), Rayon (Gr 2), Riviera (Gr 3) and Blockout (Gr 4).
Max size
Not stated on the current site.
Spec 03

Aluminium Venetians

Photo: 35mm aluminium Venetian with valance, from the current site
25 & 35mm
For smaller windows such as kitchens, bathrooms and kid’s rooms. Max width 3 metres. 25mm has no valance; 35mm comes with an aluminium valance.
50mm
For bigger windows and doors. An aluminium valance is an optional extra.
Control
Tilt angling: privacy (see out, others cannot see in) and heat control.
Care
Water-resistant slats, easy to clean.
Colours
50mm swatches include Silver, Champagne, White, Black, Brown, Cream, Silver Grey and perforated Anthracite.
Spec 04

Roller blinds, block-out

Photo: block-out roller blinds, client photo from the current site
Suits
The site pitches block-out fabric at bedrooms and at boardrooms, “creating a dark environment for presentations”.
Fabrics
Savana Block Out, Corona Block Out, Linen Block Out and Arizona Block. 100% polyester.
Max size
Up to 2800mm wide by 2500mm drop (Arizona Block: 2500mm by 2200mm).
Options
Motorisation, stainless steel chains, 45mm cassette, colour-coded components. Side channels eliminate light gaps.
Light gaps
Block-out fabric blocks sunlight but light may filter in at the sides. Fitted inside the sill there is a 25mm gap on the control side and 10mm on the other. A face-fix 50mm over the edges is recommended.

Motors, as listed on the current Shade Weave page: Mastervue battery motor R2385; remote control (1 channel) R343.

03

Fitting & fees for 5+ blinds

From the current warranty and T&C page. The fitting fee is the call-out fee for your distance from Pinetown, plus a per-blind fee. The bigger the order, the lower the per-blind fee.

Fitting fee, per blind

Per-blind fitting fees, charged on top of the call-out fee
1 or 2 blindsR150per blind
3 or 4 blindsR130per blind
5 or more blindsR110per blind
Panel blindR200per panel blind
Outdoor roller blindR500per outdoor roller

Type your window count in the project enquiry below and the matching row lights up. 5 or more is highlighted by default.

Call-out fee, by distance from Pinetown

  • Up to 30 km: R300
  • 30 to 60 km: R400
  • 60 to 90 km: R500

For measuring, the call-out is paid in cash to the consultant and refunded when you order your blinds.

Measuring: two routes

  • Measure yourself and send the sizes: extra 10% discount. Once the deposit is paid a representative verifies the measurements.
  • Ask for a measuring visit instead (call-out above).
  • Ask for self-measuring insurance when you order. It costs 3% of the total amount of your blinds; terms are on the warranty page.

Guarantee

3-year carry-in guarantee on your blinds. For a factory fault, send a photo. We then tell you whether it goes back to the factory or a technician can fix it on site (within a 50km radius of our offices). If it goes to the factory, you bring it to our offices.

Quality & fitting

All blinds get a double quality check. If you break something while fitting, bring it in and the repair is free of charge. Please check the blinds once fitted; comebacks are charged as call-out fees.

Plan for this

  • Custom-made blinds: no returns.
  • Delivery to any location in the country. A delivery fee is not published; ask when you request your quote.
  • Deposit amount is not published either; ask.
04

Cleaning & repair of existing blinds

Blind Specialist began in 1995 by cleaning and repairing blinds. The service covers vertical, Venetian and roller blinds, in Durban and the surrounding areas only. Cleaning cannot be done on site, but some repairs can.

  1. Send a photoWhatsApp a photo of the blind with your details and what is wrong. That is the quickest way to get a repair quote.
  2. Name the partsUse the parts drawings on the current site to identify what is broken. Tell Sonja if you will bring the blinds in or want them picked up, and give your address.
  3. Bring in or pick upBring the blinds to us and collect them to rehang yourself, or have us take care of removal and rehanging. A quote visit carries a call-out fee based on distance.

Pick-up and rehang fee

Under 60km around PinetownR400
60 to 100km around PinetownR500

If the drop is over 2 metres, add 10% to the prices below. Or bring your blinds in and collect them yourself.

Cleaning, per blind, by width

Blind width50mm Venetian25 or 35mm VenetianRoller
Under 1mR200R150R150
1m to 1.5mR250R200R200
1.5m to 2mR300R250R250
2m to 3mR350R300R300

50mm column covers aluminium, imitation wood and basswood Venetians. Roller prices cover classic or cassette rollers; pick-up and rehang fees apply on top. Prices as printed on the current site; Sonja confirms the exact price when you send a photo.

Vertical blinds

Cleaning per blade, drop under 1.5mR7.00
Cleaning per blade, drop over 1.5mR9.00
Repair tracks, per trackR160.00
Slatholder, eachR2.60
Bottom weight, eachR8.00
Chain, per metreR5.50

Verticals: we unclip and roll up the blades, soak them in tanks with special soap, rinse and dry. Rollers: laid on a big flat table, vacuumed with a soft upholstery brush, then wiped with a damp microfibre cloth in warm water with a tiny drop of mild detergent.

05

From enquiry to fitted

The ordering steps from the current Request a Quote page. The entire transaction can be done by email or WhatsApp.

  1. 1

    Choose

    Pick the blind type and colour from the website showroom. Samples can be sent on request.

  2. 2

    Measure

    Follow the “How to measure” guide yourself for the extra 10% discount, or ask for a measuring visit.

  3. 3

    Request

    Send sizes and requirements through the quote form, WhatsApp or email. Quotes are free.

  4. 4

    Quote & order

    We send a quote by email. After you accept it you receive an official order.

  5. 5

    Deposit & check

    After the deposit is paid, a measurer checks your measurements if you are in Durban or the surrounding areas.

  6. 6

    Made, delivered, fitted

    Blinds are made to your sizes and delivered to any location in the country. Fitting in the Durban area uses the fees above.

3-year carry-in guarantee

All blinds carry it. Because every blind is custom-made, returns are not accepted.
